name: Opening range gap (ORG / RTH ORG)
aliases: regular trading hours opening range gap

definitions.definition_text: Regular trading hours settlement cited at 4:14 p.m.; opening range gap framed from that settlement vs 9:30 open (RTHORG high/low labels depending on whether open is above/below settlement).
conditions: Uses RTH settlement (lecture: 4:14 p.m.) as anchor
Gap exists when 9:30 open differs from prior RTH settlement
definitions.variations_note: Settlement clock 4:14 in lecture; Karen desk notes sometimes use 4:15 — keep as source variation, do not silently rewrite.

definitions.definition_text: After seeing ORG deliver more times than not toward half gap / CE: student perspective shifts to only look for shorts in premium gaps in the first 30 minutes of trading; aim for half gap; best-case 3/4 gap.
definitions.variations_note: Directional lean for premium gaps — keep separate from discount-gap willingness language in uwFJ0t7SAOU.

definitions.definition_text: Inside the first 30 minutes on a gap down: measure willingness for price to get back to previous session close; if no immediate dire need to reprice back up, that means extremely bearish — then turn attention to deeper discount objectives on 15-minute / hourly / daily.
invalidation: No willingness to reprice toward previous session close → extremely bearish framing (failure of immediate fill attempt)
definitions.variations_note: Complementary to premium-gap short lean; opposite gap polarity. Keep as separate occurrence.

definitions.definition_text: In the 2025 ORG lecture series, ICT cross-links Opening Range Gaps teaching with the morning first-presented FVG rule (since 9:31; cannot be the gap if it forms on the 9:30 candle) while walking live ORG / NFP examples.
conditions: ORG lecture context with RTH open examples
Cross-reference to FPFVG morning rule (see first_presented_fvg occurrence fpfvg_931_not_930_candle__pM8oWrcIJqU__1487)
definitions.timeframe_session_context: NY AM; ORG + FPFVG taught together in same lecture
definitions.variations_note: Not a full ORG geometry definition — catalogue cross-link only. Primary FPFVG clock rule lives under first_presented_fvg.

source.title: 2025 Lecture Series - SMC Trading Opening Range Gaps

definitions.definition_text: Students confuse new day opening gap (NDOG) with opening range gap (ORG). Chart must show regular trading hours (RTH), not electronic trading hours (ETH), with New York timezone — RTH toggle typically shown as RTH/ETH in the lower-right corner.
invalidation: ETH chart mode shows NDOG/NWOG constructs instead of ORG
definitions.timeframe_session_context: RTH chart setup before measuring ORG
definitions.variations_note: Definitional disambiguation ORG ≠ NDOG; keep separate from settlement geometry rows.

source.title: 2025 Lecture Series - SMC Opening Range Gaps

definitions.definition_text: On RTH chart, ORG is the difference between previous-day regular trading hours settlement at 4:14 p.m. and the first opening price at 9:30 Eastern (New York local). Opening higher than prior RTH settlement is classified as a premium opening range gap. If the ORG is 120 handles or larger, price could leave the gap unfilled.
conditions: Prior day settlement at 4:14 p.m. ET
invalidation: Large ORG (≥~120 handles): may leave gap unfilled (does not fully return to prior settlement)
definitions.variations_note: Official 4:14 settlement clock (reinforces eft9). KEEP SEPARATE from large-gap unfilled rule vs ~70% CE-fill language in consequent_encroachment_half_gap.

source.title: 2025 Lecture Series - SMC Opening Range Gaps

definitions.definition_text: For a premium ORG: take Fibonacci, anchor to previous RTH settlement at 4:14 on a 1-minute chart, drag to next trading day 9:30 Eastern opening price (RTH toggled) to obtain quadrant levels used for ORG analysis.
definitions.variations_note: Operational geometry for quadrant/CE levels; complements V5 octant/quadrant grading occurrence.

source.title: 2025 Lecture Series - SMC Opening Range Gaps

definitions.definition_text: With a large gap (couple hundred handles / ~120 handles ballpark): rules employed say it will probably keep going in the direction of an extreme gap; if it ever trades below that low (settlement side), usually it stops around the upper quadrant — 25% of the opening range gap is usually what is traded there. Gap may stay unfilled (not return all the way to previous day settlement) though it may fill at a later time.
invalidation: May not trade even to upper quadrant; full fill may be deferred beyond the day
definitions.timeframe_session_context: Large premium ORG; first reaction often limited to upper quadrant / 25%
definitions.variations_note: CONFLICT FACTOR vs ~70% CE attempt claims — large-gap may leave unfilled / only reach 25%. Do not merge with CE 70% rows.

source.title: 2025 Lecture Series - SMC Opening Range Gaps

definitions.definition_text: Opening range gap is defined by regular trading hours only. Whatever trades between 6:00 p.m. and 9:30 is shown in electronic hours and is not needed for ORG. ETH shows new day opening gaps and/or new week opening gaps; RTH denotes what the opening range gap will be if there is a gap.
invalidation: Using ETH chart for ORG measurement → wrong construct (NDOG/NWOG)
definitions.variations_note: Reinforces org_neq_ndog; kept separate as explicit RTH-only definition + ETH NDOG/NWOG mapping.

source.title: 2025 Lecture Series - SMC Opening Range Gaps

definitions.definition_text: On 1-minute RTH chart: hover Friday last candle — shows 4:14 p.m. close; wait until 9:30 New York local Monday RTH open; the difference between Friday closing price and Monday opening price is the opening range gap.
definitions.variations_note: Same 4:14→9:30 geometry as uIvl/eft9; weekend framing explicit. KEEP SEPARATE from same-video Judas 9:30–10:00 opening range (time window ≠ gap).

source.title: 2023 ICT Mentorship - Opening Range Gap Repricing Macro

definitions.definition_text: Opening range gap lower (open below Friday close) = discount opening range gap. Opening range gap higher (open above Friday close) = opening range gap premium.
conditions: Compare 9:30 open to prior RTH close/settlement
definitions.variations_note: Polarity labels; keep separate from premium-short-lean / discount-willingness behavioral rows.

source.title: 2023 ICT Mentorship - Opening Range Gap Repricing Macro

definitions.definition_text: For RTH ORG: the open on the 9:30 candlestick to the last/final print showing on the RTH chart are the only two reference points really needed (CME website alternatives acknowledged but not required).
conditions: Two anchors: 9:30 open and prior session final/last print
definitions.variations_note: Pairs with explicit 4:14 last-print labeling in same lecture; keep as two-point rule separate from Fib grading steps.

source.title: Chain Of Custody Of Price With RTH ORG

definitions.definition_text: In the Monday discount-gap example: highest point of the RTH opening range gap is the 9:30 opening price; lowest point is the last print for Friday at 4:14 p.m. Eastern (low of the RTH ORG / settlement side).
definitions.timeframe_session_context: Monday RTH ORG after Friday settlement
definitions.variations_note: Geometry polarity for discount gap (high=open, low=settlement). Premium case in uIvl inverts labels (open above settlement). Do not merge premium/discount high-low labeling.

source.title: Chain Of Custody Of Price With RTH ORG

definitions.definition_text: Use the RTH opening range gap concept by grading it, then look for key PD arrays that form on the octant and the quadrant levels.
conditions: PD arrays aligning to those levels
definitions.timeframe_session_context: RTH ORG graded levels as delivery map
definitions.variations_note: Adds octant language alongside quadrants; complements uIvl Fib quadrant setup.

source.title: Chain Of Custody Of Price With RTH ORG

definitions.definition_text: Live commentary: since we gap lower with a discount gap we are likely to see a trade lower; also notes open traded up to about a quarter (lower quadrant of the gap) in the example.
definitions.timeframe_session_context: Live RTH ORG review / futures commentary
definitions.variations_note: Behavioral lean for discount gaps (continue lower) — KEEP SEPARATE from uwFJ0t7SAOU willingness-to-reprice-up framing and from premium-short-lean rows.
